audit.description: Changed production code in certbot_dns_infomaniak/dns_infomaniak.py removes the direct requests import and imports urllib3 instead. The implementation constructs a real urllib3.PoolManager in _HTTPClient.__init__, and dynamic evidence records urllib3 imported from site-packages plus PoolManager attribute access from production code. Static and dynamic evidence show no requests imports or source namespace use from production repo code; the observed requests imports come from the external requests_mock dependency only. No local urllib3 provider or target-named shim is added.
